recognize_zh: 多格血片中可見多種形態的大型反應性淋巴細胞：細胞質豐富淡藍色，邊緣向外加深變藍並「包住」周圍紅血球（Downey II），核形不規則或凹陷，低倍視野中這類細胞明顯增加，符合傳染性單核球增多症。
features: Large reactive lymphocytes with abundant pale-to-gray-blue cytoplasm and a low-to-moderate N:C ratio
Cytoplasm with peripheral basophilia that scallops around or indents adjacent red cells (Downey type II)
Nuclei round, indented or irregular with moderately condensed chromatin; occasional cells with deeper basophilia (Downey type III)
Heterogeneous spectrum of lymphocyte morphology rather than a uniform population
Low-power fields show increased numbers of atypical lymphocytes; red cells and platelets unremarkable
describe_en: Composite of peripheral blood smear fields shows an increased number of large atypical (reactive) lymphocytes, well seen at low power. The cells have abundant pale-blue cytoplasm with peripheral basophilia that molds around and is indented by adjacent red cells, with round to indented or irregular nuclei and moderately condensed chromatin. The population is morphologically heterogeneous, and no blasts are evident. Red cell and platelet morphology are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with reactive lymphocytosis of infectious mononucleosis (predominantly Downey type II cells), confirmed serologically as acute EBV infection.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are a monotonous population with fine blastic chromatin, scant cytoplasm and nucleoli, not a heterogeneous spectrum of large cells with abundant scalloping cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Other viral lymphocytosis (CMV, acute HIV, viral hepatitis)
ddx.vs: Morphology is indistinguishable, so serology (heterophile, EBV VCA IgM, CMV IgM) or PCR is required.
LGL cells have abundant cytoplasm with distinct azurophilic granules and a persistent clonal population, rather than agranular basophilic cytoplasm hugging red cells.
Monocytes have gray, finely granular vacuolated cytoplasm with folded lacy chromatin and do not show the peripheral basophilia and red-cell scalloping of reactive lymphocytes.
